items.t: Cranks but won't start (fuel pump main relay)
items.note: Hours include basic no-start testing. Replacing the fuel pump costs far more, so rule out the relay first.

items.t: Distributor failure: stalling or no spark
items.note: Owners on CarComplaints paid about $650 to $1,600, often along with other work.

items.t: Oil leak at the distributor and check engine light
items.note: If oil got inside the distributor, it may need replacing.

items.t: Squeal from the distributor that sounds like a loose belt
Rough, high or hunting idle
items.job: Clean throttle body, fast idle valve and idle air control valve
items.note: Parts cost only applies if the idle air control valve must be replaced.

items.t: Oil leaks from the valve cover gasket and cam plug
items.job: Replace valve cover gasket and cam plug O-ring
items.note: RepairPal lists $258–$289 for the valve cover gasket on 1992–2001 Integras.

items.t: Radiator cracks and leaks coolant
items.note: RepairPal lists $1,043–$1,151 at shops for 1994–2001; aftermarket radiators cost much less than OEM.

items.t: Sunroof leaks water inside
Knocking from worn rear trailing arm bushings
items.note: Needs a press tool. No alignment needed.

items.t: Temperature gauge reads low or stops moving
Alternator stops charging
Water in the trunk from leaking taillight seals
A/C stops blowing cold (compressor failure)
items.job: Replace A/C compressor, drier and recharge
items.note: RepairPal lists $1,357–$1,583 total for the RSX.

items.t: Check engine light from the VTC oil control valve
items.job: Clean or replace VTC oil control valve and screen

items.t: Check engine light from a failed EVAP purge valve
items.note: RepairPal lists $329–$350 for the RSX.

items.t: Timing chain or tensioner rattle and cam timing codes
items.note: RepairPal lists $375–$506. A stretched chain and guides add several hundred dollars.

items.t: Clutch master cylinder squeaks, then fails
items.job: Replace clutch master cylinder and bleed
items.note: RepairPal lists $371–$411.

items.t: Power window cable snaps or window sticks
items.note: RepairPal lists $859–$893; aftermarket regulators cost less.

items.t: Power door locks won't lock or unlock
items.note: RepairPal lists $200–$417.

items.t: Broken engine or transmission mount
items.note: RepairPal lists $602–$636.

items.t: Check engine light from a failed oxygen sensor
items.note: RepairPal lists $675–$898 depending on year; aftermarket sensors cost less.

items.t: Starter clicks or won't crank
items.note: RepairPal lists $549–$657 for 2003–2005 and up to $1,725 for some years.

items.t: Exhaust leak or rattle at the header flex joint
items.job: Replace exhaust flex pipe or gasket

items.t: Harsh or noisy automatic downshifts when slowing
items.job: Change transmission fluid and update software
items.note: A failed shift solenoid adds parts cost.

items.t: Sticky or notchy steering (recall)
items.job: Replace steering gearbox worm gear spring and regrease
items.note: Free at an Acura dealer under recall 24V-744.

items.t: Stability control unit may leak brake fluid (recall)
items.note: Free under recall 23V-430.

items.t: Driver seat frame may be loose (recall)
items.note: Free under recalls 24V-859 and 26V-054.

items.t: Check engine light with code P0011 (valve timing)
items.job: Update engine software and relearn cam timing
items.note: Covered under Acura's warranty on these new cars.

items.t: Door window weatherstrip comes loose
items.job: Reinstall or replace door sash weatherstrip
items.note: Covered under warranty on these new cars.
